messages.subject: New spOccupancy and spAbundance users google group
parts:
Welcome to the spOccupancy/spAbundance users google group! I created this group for questions and discussions related to the spOccupancy and spAbundance R packages and associated methods. Up to this point, I have been handling questions from users on an individual basis via email, but this google group will now be the primary place to receive help on the package. This will make it easier for users to see past questions/solutions, as well as allow others to chime in with some thoughts for when I'm slow to respond :) Of course if you have questions that involve your specific data set that you do not wish to make public, then feel free to email me your data separately. In that case, I would still ask you to post your inquiry on the page, as the question/answers may still be helpful to others.

In addition to this group, the package websites contain a variety of vignettes and articles that you will find useful when getting going with an analysis using the packages. I have also given a few workshops on the packages, and you may find the scripts/materials to be helpful as well.
  • spOccupancy website: https://doserlab.com/files/spoccupancy-web/
  • spAbundance website: https://doserlab.com/files/spabundance-web/
  • List of workshops and links to material: https://doserlab.com/event/

Thanks!

Jeff
